opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an exceptional, independent researcher with a permanent or fixed‑term UK university or UK not‑for‑profit research organisation appointment, able to be relieved from teaching and admin duties; co‑applicants must be exceptional researchers from a different Academy remit and also based in a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for established researchers to undertake interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven projects that combine the humanities, social sciences, engineering and natural sciences, up to 24 months and £200 k.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation, holding a permanent or fixed‑term position for the award duration; must have completed their viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027 and not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships for early‑career researchers to complete a significant piece of publishable research in the humanities or social sciences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026‑27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK higher‑education institution or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £10 k for skill‑development projects (e.g., quantitative methods, data science, digital humanities) lasting 6–12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: PI must be a UK‑based researcher in the humanities or social sciences with an established role; co‑applicants must be based overseas; projects must be genuinely interdisciplinary and address the theme of mobilities.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects led by UK humanities/social sciences researchers, up to £300 k, focusing on international mobilities of people, materials, ideas, etc.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026‑27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑career or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; must be able to spend a year based at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP, offering up to £150 k to develop policy‑relevant analysis in security, Indo‑European relations, technology/AI, or strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a three‑day symposium on ‘Humans and Nature’, with seed funding for collaborative projects developed during the event.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding for specific additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility support) to assist award‑holders or applicants.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher (any career stage) proposing a public‑engagement project with a GLAM or performing‑arts partner.
opportunities.summary: Public‑engagement awards of up to £8 k for projects running between April 2027 and December 2028.
